The name 'Facebook Icon' is partially redundant — the word 'Icon' is not descriptive of the destination. However, the full SR speech includes 'Wayfair's Facebook Page' which provides context. The AX name alone ('Facebook Icon') is suboptimal — 'icon' adds no information. Borderline 2.4.4: the name identifies the brand (Facebook) but appends a meaningless 'Icon' suffix. REPRODUCED as a minor 2.4.4 concern — 'Facebook Icon' does not describe the link destination as well as 'Wayfair on Facebook' would.

issues.evidence: No <main> landmark. Four <nav> elements with no aria-label/aria-labelledby — indistinguishable to AT.
10 <ul>/<ol> elements have list-style:none without role='list' — strips list semantics in Safari/VoiceOver.
Link name 'See all' is ambiguous — does not describe the destination out of context.
No focus indicator on 'See all' link — computed-only method, indicatorPresent=false, outline:none, no box-shadow, tabWalk outlineOrShadow:false.
Joss & Main header brand link: visibleDiffPct=0, el5.png vs el5_focus.png are identical — no perceivable focus indicator. Box-shadow on purple background is imperceptible.
Nav dropdown toggle button at x=-9999 is in the tab order (reachedByTab=true) but is off-screen — focus lands on an invisible element (2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured).
Off-screen button (x=-9999): outline:none, no box-shadow, indicatorPresent=false. Even if indicator applied, element is invisible at that position.

tabWalk.noOutlineStops=37 of 50. The majority of focusable elements in the header nav (stops 17–50) show outlineOrShadow:false, confirming a widespread missing-focus-indicator pattern across all primary nav links and dropdown buttons.

Product listing link at tabIndex 315 — not reachable by keyboard tab within any reasonable number of keystrokes (local walk cap exceeded). Hundreds of carousel/product links effectively inaccessible by sequential keyboard navigation.
Category 'Bathroom' link: visibleDiffPct=0, indicatorPresent=false, outline:none 0px, no box-shadow. el14.png vs el14_focus.png identical. No focus ring.
Footer email input: visibleDiffPct=0, indicatorPresent=false, outline:none, no box-shadow. No focus ring on the email subscription input.

Footer email form: nativeValidationOnly=true, ariaInvalidSet=false, alertAppeared=false, errorAnnouncedLive=false. No ARIA error identification mechanism — errors rely solely on browser native validation. scriptsDisabled prevents full verification. PARTIAL.

Social icon link axName='Facebook Icon' — the word 'Icon' is meaningless in the name. SR reads 'Facebook Icon, Wayfair's Facebook Page' but the AX name alone is 'Facebook Icon' which is suboptimal for out-of-context reading.

axe reports 129 label-content-name-mismatch violations. Product listing links have aria-label with full product name, but visible link text shows promotional text ('Spring Cyber Week') — the aria-label does not match the visible text content. This violates 2.5.3 Label in Name (WCAG 2.1, A). Example: a[aria-label='Marrina 31.5"W Modern Coffee Table...'] but innerText='Spring Cyber Week'.
